summary.text: Ann Bollin is a Republican member of the Michigan House of Representatives representing District 49 and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ann Bollin's general-election opponents are Dan Pelchat (D) and Trevor Step (L).
She chairs the House Appropriations Committee and lives in Brighton Township.

paragraphs.text: Ann Bollin lives in Brighton Township, Michigan.

She has served on the Greater Brighton Area Chamber of Commerce Board of Directors, the Michigan Townships Association Board of Directors, and the Michigan Association of Municipal Clerks Legislative Committee.
Bollin has served on the House Appropriations Committee since at least 2019-2020 and chairs it in 2025-2026.
In 2021-2022 she also chaired the Elections and Ethics Committee.
